headline: Turkish Outbound Travel Spending Reaches $8.2 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Outbound travel spending by Turkish citizens reached $8.23 billion in the first nine months of 2026 as the number of outbound travelers increased, according to official data from the Turkish Statistical Institute.
why: Outbound tourism expenditure represents foreign exchange outflows that directly influence Turkey's current account balance and domestic liquidity conditions.

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Elevated outbound spending increases foreign currency demand, affecting current account balances.
